questions.q: Which queen refused to come at the king's command?
questions.evidence: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs

questions.q: Who brought up Esther as his own daughter?
questions.evidence: and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter

questions.q: Who sought to destroy all the Jews throughout the kingdom of Ahasuerus?
questions.evidence: Therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus

questions.q: Who told Esther she may have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
questions.evidence: Mordecai asked them return answer to Esther, “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews. For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this

questions.q: What did Esther say as she resolved to go to the king unsummoned?
questions.evidence: and if I perish, I perish

questions.q: Who was hanged on the gallows he had prepared for Mordecai?
questions.evidence: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai

questions.q: What were the days called, after the lot Haman cast?
questions.evidence: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur

questions.q: What happened when Esther came before the king's fierce anger?
questions.evidence: Then lifting up his countenance that was flushed with glory, he looked upon her in fierce anger: and the queen fell down, and turned pale, and fainted, and she bowed herself upon the head of the maid that went before
